test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The population of a town increased by 10% every year. If the present population is 20,000, in the next year it will be:
solution:
**Given:**

The population of a town increased = 10%

Present population = 20,000

**Concept used:**

Percentage increase will be successive percentage increase

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ 20,000 + 20,000 × 10/100

⇒ 20,000 + 2000

⇒ 22,000

**∴ The population of town in the next year will be 22,000**
